.codespace/architecture.json.summary: This repository's architecture: its layers, and each file's layer, tags, and summary, which the map reads.

AGENTS.md.summary: What an agent working here should know first: the commands, the architecture-file rule, and the ingest loop.

README.md.summary: What Codespace is, how to run it, and the CLI an agent uses to describe a repository.

docs/FUTURE.md.summary: Ideas deliberately deferred, written so they can be picked up later.

docs/architecture.md.summary: The architecture file: its fields, the tag vocabulary, and the rules for generated code.

docs/review-rubric.md.summary: The code-health review rubric for a change set in this repository.

package-lock.json.summary: The locked dependency tree, generated by npm.

package.json.summary: The project's name, scripts, and dependencies.

public/babylon.d.ts.summary: The slice of the Babylon.js global the page uses, so the browser code type-checks.

public/batch.ts.summary: Draws many copies of one shape in a single call, each copy with its own spot, size, and colour.

public/boxes.ts.summary: Draws every file box as a batched crowd, lends standout files a mesh of their own, and finds the box under the pointer.

public/city.ts.summary: Lays the folder tree out as a treemap and turns each file into a positioned box.

public/controls.ts.summary: Wires the buttons, slider, search, shortcuts, and colour menu, and polls the repository, redrawing only when its fingerprint moves.

public/edges.ts.summary: Draws imports as bundled strands with moving direction dots, plus pillars from lifted files to the floor.

public/highlight.ts.summary: Paints files and folder tiles to match the selection, hover, and tag filter.

public/index.html.summary: The page: the canvas, the search box, the panels, and the controls the map is drawn into.

public/labels.ts.summary: Places the HTML name, tag, layer, and step labels over the 3D scene without letting them overlap.

public/main.ts.summary: Boots the page: picking and hover with the pointer, the per-frame render loop, and the first load.

public/meshes.ts.summary: Lays out each file's record, the folder tiles, layer planes, and ground grid, grows new boxes in, and glides the camera.

public/pads.ts.summary: Draws a ring on each file's own layer plane under its block, in the layer's colour, so a file's layer reads at a glance.

public/panels.ts.summary: Fills the info, legend, and folders panels, with breadcrumbs, repository stats, tag filtering, and a highlighted code view.

public/repo-switch.ts.summary: The Repo picker: open another folder, list recent ones, and show how much is left to describe.

public/repo.ts.summary: Reads the repository through the server into folder nodes, import edges, line counts, symbols, tags, layers, summaries, and changed lines.

public/route.ts.summary: Spreads the files of a shown route along a shallow arc in a clear lane in front of the plan, each at its own layer height, so no strand crosses an unrelated block.

public/state.ts.summary: The shared world: constants, the Babylon scene and camera, colours, every mutable value the other modules read, and the path of a file within a folder.

public/style.css.summary: The page's stylesheet: the panels, labels, and controls.

public/types.ts.summary: The shapes the page shares: the folder tree, each file's record, the colouring mode, and what a tool asks the map to show.

public/view.ts.summary: Listens for what tools ask the map to show, lights those files up, and lists them with their explanations.

src/cli/Cli.ts.summary: The commands an agent runs to describe a repository: what is left, the next batch to read, and applying each batch.

src/repo/Architecture.ts.summary: Reads and safely changes a repository's architecture file: the layers, tags, and summaries the map shows.

src/repo/Graph.ts.summary: Reads the imports between code files, relative for TypeScript and JavaScript and by namespace for C#, into a graph the tools can query.

src/repo/Ingest.ts.summary: Chooses what an agent reads next to describe the codebase: files without a summary, then folders, settling generated code on the way.

src/repo/Repo.ts.summary: Reads a folder as a repository: lists its files, honours .gitignore, reads source safely, and stamps what changed.

src/server/Api.ts.summary: The endpoints the page uses: the architecture, the import graph, the ingest status, and what the map shows.

src/server/Guard.ts.summary: Decides who may change anything: only requests from this machine, as a local host name, as JSON, from this site.

src/server/Server.ts.summary: Serves the page, the repository, changes, and fingerprint API, and the MCP endpoint at /mcp, which starts with the server.

src/server/View.ts.summary: Holds what the map is asked to show and streams changes to every page that is watching.

src/server/Workspace.ts.summary: Holds the repository being read and the recent ones, so the map can switch between them without restarting.

tests/Api.test.ts.summary: Tests the API: reads, refused changes, validation, the view and its replay to a late page.

tests/Architecture.test.ts.summary: Tests that the architecture file is read and trimmed, and that stale or malformed entries are reported.

tests/Graph.test.ts.summary: Tests the import graph: C# files linked by the namespaces their using directives name, and TypeScript by relative specifier.

tests/Guard.test.ts.summary: Tests who may change anything: this machine or localhost by default, anyone with --allow-writes, never cross-site.

tests/Ingest.test.ts.summary: Tests that ingest settles generated files, hands out files with their imports, then folders deepest first.

tests/Repo.test.ts.summary: Tests that Repo lists readable files, refuses paths and symlinks outside the repository, and follows .gitignore.

tests/Workspace.test.ts.summary: Tests that a workspace opens, switches, and keeps repositories recent without moving when a folder cannot be opened.

tsconfig.json.summary: The TypeScript compiler settings for the project.

tsconfig.web.json.summary: The TypeScript compiler settings for the browser code in public/; npm run build emits their JavaScript beside them.

.codespace.summary: Codespace metadata, written by the map and its tools rather than by hand.

docs.summary: How the architecture file works, the review rubric, and ideas deliberately deferred.

public.summary: The browser side: the 3D city, its panels, and the controls that drive it.

src.summary: The server side: reading repositories, the architecture file, the ingest commands, and the HTTP server.

src/cli.summary: The commands an agent runs to describe a repository.

src/repo.summary: Reads and checks a repository: its files, imports, architecture file, and what to ingest next.

src/server.summary: Serves the page and the endpoints the map and the tools use, changing files only from this machine.

tests.summary: Tests for the repository reading, the architecture file, ingest, the workspace, the guard, and the API.
